title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Triage Agent gains metadata instructions, combined settings and its own Entra identity
notes: claim 88: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
the verifier wrote "hold" but listed no blocker and fewer than three majors; the claims decide, so the page is not held
summary: Held because three descriptions go beyond the documentation: that account changes stop the agent, that it does not change policies, and that the enhancements do not affect end users. The roadmap facts, licensing sources and documented control routes were checked; the page also needs to acknowledge a further disagreement about metadata instructions.
